_about: Decision pages kept out of the run-up study, each with its reason. 35 are pages whose cited primary source was re-read on 2026-11-18 and does not support the FDA action on the page date: verify_decisions.py (2026-08-12) accepted any SEC filing within 14 days containing "approval of", "FDA approval" or "complete response letter"; 82 pages rested on such a match and 35 did not hold up (shareholder votes, warrants, financing papers, earnings recaps, a Phase 2 data release). Two are a second page for one FDA action (IRON-2026-02-15, VNDA-2026-02-21) and one is dated days after the action it reports (SNY-2025-12-28), so its price window starts after the news. Remove an entry only with a source that states the action on that date; a page re-dated to the true action date gets a new id and enters the study on its own. Entries for dates before 2025 are rows of the 2020 to 2024 research set, which has no decision pages; they are keyed the same way. 2026-11-18 later the same day: 19 of the 35 (ABBV-2026-02-20, AMPH-2026-02-24, AZN-2026-02-20, AZN-2026-04-27, AZN-2026-05-15, AZN-2026-05-18, BIIB-2026-03-30, GSK-2026-03-13, HRMY-2026-02-17, LGND-2026-04-13, MNKD-2026-05-29, MRK-2026-04-21, NVO-2025-01-28, NVO-2026-03-26, PGEN-2025-08-15, REGN-2026-04-22, REGN-2026-04-23, SNY-2026-04-22, TAK-2025-06-30) were re-sourced to the FDA letter or record, or the company's own release, which states the action or its announcement on the page date (apply_1118b_decision_sources.py), so they re-enter the study; the rest were retired or re-dated (apply_1118_retire_decisions.py).

CAPR-2024-09-24.reason: research row records an FDA APPROVAL for deramiocel, which has never been approved

The 2024-09-24 row recorded an APPROVAL; on 13 November 2024, after that date, Capricor still described deramiocel as not approved for any indication. Design red team 2026-11-18.
